title: Native Ringed Restriction Local Test
statement: Under a dense equivalence of ringed sites with the indicated sheafification and derived-category structures globally and on slices, restriction of the principal localization test for (N,U,s) is isomorphic to the test for the restricted derived object, object and compatible slice section. The test uses exact derived slice restriction and sheafified sectionwise localization; no equality of site and coefficient universes is assumed. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-slices], [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-localization], [def-pur-ringed-principal-local-tests].

proof.text: The derived localization test commutes with restriction to the equivalent slice. Compare derived internal Hom, compare the localized module by the localization restriction isomorphism, and compare its degree-zero derived object. The exact derived slice square compares the second Hom argument. Compose these isomorphisms, reversing the localization isomorphism in the contravariant argument. Source: Stacks 03A0, 03CH, 03DA, 03DG, 08J7 and 0999.

theorem localTestRestriction (U : C)
    (N : DerivedCategory (NativeModules.{max c d vc vd r, d, vd} R))
    (s : ((R.over (F.obj U)).obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    let Ts := restrictModules.{max c vc, max d vd, vc, vd, r}
      (K := K.over U) (Over.post F) (R.over (F.obj U))
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{w} (NativeModules.{max c d vc vd r, max d vd, vd}
      (R.over (F.obj U))) := inferInstanceAs
        (HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c d vc vd r} ((Rg).over (F.obj U))))
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{w} (NativeModules.{max c d vc vd r, max c vc, vc}
      (restrictedCommRing.{max c vc, max d vd, vc, vd, r} (K := K.over U)
        (Over.post F) (R.over (F.obj U)))) := inferInstanceAs
        (HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c d vc vd r} ((Rs).over U)))
    Nonempty (Ts.mapDerivedCategory.obj
      (principalLocalTest.{d, vd, max c vc r, w} R N (F.obj U) s) ≅
        principalLocalTest.{c, vc, max d vd r, w} S
          ((restrictModules.{c, d, vc, vd, r} (K := K) F R).mapDerivedCategory.obj N) U
          (restrictedSection.{max c vc, max d vd, vc, vd, r}
            (K := K.over U) (Over.post F) (R.over (F.obj U)) s))
